name: Mournwind Courtier

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Return to Mourning
traits.details: If a Mournwind courtier is dead at the start of her turn, but the Prince of Frost still lives, roll a d20. on a roll of 11 or higher, the courtier returns to life with 1 hit point in a space within 5 squares of the Prince of Frost, free of all conditions.

hit.description: cold damage, and the target cannot make opportunity attacks against the courtier until the end of her next turn

effect.description: The courtier shifts 8 squares, including through occupied spaces. She can make a melee basic attack as a free action against any enemy whose space she moves through
The courtier adds her voice to a cry of lament. If she is the second Sister of Lament to do so in a round, the chorus of lament (see below) goes off

powers.name: Chorus of lament
powers.range: Two close bursts 3, one centered on each Sister of Lament

attacks.name: Hit
attacks.range: Two close bursts 3, one centered on each Sister of Lament

hit.description: psychic and cold damage, and target is dazed (save ends)
